platform.generation.InjectionConfig.description: The state injection related configuration in AgentScope.

inject_runtime_state.description: Inject the runtime state to context, including current time,tasks state, context length, etc.
inject_runtime_state.title: Inject Runtime State

time_format.description: The format to inject and parse the time information, which must round-trip a full timestamp, i.e. carry the date part. A time-only format such as '%H:%M:%S' makes the parsed time fall back to year 1900, so that the time is injected in every iteration.
time_format.title: Time Format

time_interval.description: The minimum time interval in hours from the last injection to trigger new time injection
time_interval.title: Time Interval

context_buffer_ratio.description: Deprecated, use the 'context_buffer_ratio' of the context config instead. When provided, it overrides the one in the context config.
context_buffer_ratio.title: Context Buffer

tool_retries_limit.description: The number of consecutive failures of the same tool call that triggers the tool error injection.
tool_retries_limit.title: Tool Retries Limit

tool_retries_hint.default: The last {count} calls to '{tool_name}' with the same arguments all failed. Stop retrying the same call as-is, check the error message and try a different approach.
tool_retries_hint.description: The hint injected when the same tool call keeps failing, where the '{tool_name}' and '{count}' placeholders will be replaced by the failing tool name and the number of consecutive failures.
tool_retries_hint.title: Tool Retries Hint

template.default:
<system-reminder>Treat the following as the ground truth at this point of the conversation. Anything stated earlier is outdated, and a later reminder, if any, supersedes this one:
{runtime_state}
</system-reminder>
template.description: The template to wrap the injected runtime state, where the '{runtime_state}' placeholder will be replaced by the injected fields.
template.title: Template

injection_source.description: The source of the injected hint block, which is also used to identify the previous injections within the context.
injection_source.title: Injection Source

task_tool_names.description: The names of the task related tools. Their presence in the context suppresses the tasks injection.
task_tool_names.title: Task Tool Names

extra_fields.description: The extra fields to inject, which will be wrapped into the '<{key}>{value}</{key}>' format.
extra_fields.title: Extra Fields

emit_hint_event.description: If emit the HintBlockEvent when runtime state injection happens.
emit_hint_event.title: Emit Hint Event

platform.generation.InjectionConfig.title: InjectionConfig

max_iters.description: The maximum number of reasoning-acting iterations in one reply
max_iters.title: Max Iterations

structured_output_grace_iters.description: The grace iterations for structured output when exceeding the max iterations
structured_output_grace_iters.title: Grace Iters for Structured Output

stop_on_reject.description: Whether to stop replying when being rejected to execute tools.
stop_on_reject.title: Rejection Handling

interruption_message.default: I notice the interruption. How can I help you?
interruption_message.description: The quick reply message when interrupted.
interruption_message.title: Interruption Message

interruption_raise_cancelled_error.description: Whether to re-raise ``asyncio.CancelledError`` after handling the interruption. When ``False``, the ``CancelledError`` is swallowed once the interruption context has been produced.
interruption_raise_cancelled_error.title: Raise CancelledError on Interruption

name.description: User-facing display name for this credential.
name.title: Name

base_url.description: The base URL for the OpenAI API. Can be used for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
base_url.title: Base Url

DataBlock.description: The data block for binary content (images, audio, video, etc.).
DataBlock.title: DataBlock

ErrorInfo.description: Structured, UI-facing description of a fatal reply error.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

ErrorType.description:
Classification of a fatal error that terminated a reply.

Not model-specific: the status-derived members apply to any upstream
service reached during a reply (chat model, embedding, TTS, MCP).
ErrorType.title: ErrorType

HintBlock.description:
A block used to provide instructions or hints to the LLM during the
reasoning-acting loop. When passed to the LLM API, the hint block is
converted into a user message.

The ``hint`` field can be a plain string (text-only) or a list of
:class:`TextBlock` / :class:`DataBlock` for multimodal content
(e.g. a background tool result containing both text and an image).
HintBlock.title: HintBlock

PermissionBehavior.description:
The behavior of permission.

Attributes:
    ALLOW: Allow the operation
    DENY: Deny the operation
    ASK: Ask the user for permission
    PASSTHROUGH: Let the permission engine continue with rule matching
        (used by tools to defer decision to the engine)
PermissionBehavior.title: PermissionBehavior

PermissionRule.description:
Permission rule for tool usage.

A permission rule defines whether a specific tool or tool operation
should be allowed, denied, or require user confirmation. The
rule_content field has different semantics depending on the tool_name:

- For "Bash": rule_content is a substring pattern matched against the
  command Example: rule_content="npm install" matches "npm install express"

- For "Write"/"Read": rule_content is a glob pattern matched against file
  paths Example: rule_content="src/**" matches "src/main.py"

- For other tools: rule_content is a tool-specific filter pattern
PermissionRule.title: PermissionRule

ThinkingBlock.description:
The thinking block.

Allows extra provider-specific fields (e.g. Anthropic's ``signature``,
``redacted_thinking_data``) via ``extra="allow"`` so that model
implementations can pass arbitrary metadata without subclassing.

.. note::
    Anthropic's ``redacted_thinking`` blocks are also stored as
    ``ThinkingBlock`` instances with ``thinking=""`` and the
    encrypted payload in the ``redacted_thinking_data`` extra
    field. Callers filtering by ``type=="thinking"`` (e.g.
    ``get_content_blocks``) will receive both visible and
    redacted blocks.
ThinkingBlock.title: ThinkingBlock

ToolCallState.description: The state of the tool call.
ToolCallState.title: ToolCallState

Usage.description: The token usage information of a message.
Usage.title: Usage
